name: Fynlo
summary: Vendor payments app UI: a payments table, an invoice builder with live preview, and a dated audit log of actions.
description: A vendor payments application interface: a table of 1,823 payments with amount, currency, status, due date, category and initiator; a create-invoice screen with line items, discount, tax and a live preview; and an audit log grouping status changes, amount edits, bulk uploads and auto flags by day, down to time and IP address. All data shown is demo data.
contains: views: vendor payments, invoices, audit log
payment fields: id, vendor, amount, currency, status, due date, category, initiator
invoice builder with line items, 5% discount, 11% tax and live preview
audit log with status changes, amount edits, bulk uploads, auto flags and IP addresses
